stem: Trey is describing his labor and income. Which statement could be a description of both labor and income for Trey?

options.label: F
options.text: Trey does volunteer work at a hospital.

options.label: G
options.text: Trey pays a company to repair his roof.

options.label: H
options.text: Trey takes $25 out of his bank account and spends the money at a store.

options.label: J
options.text: Trey takes dogs for a walk after school and earns $25.

difficulty_rationale: This question requires understanding of the concepts of labor and income and selecting the statement that describes both. It is a direct recall/recognition of definitions without multi-step reasoning.
